meta.parties: Buddharakkitha Thero v. The Public Trustee Et Al

rules.statement: The Public Trustee is not required to issue a letter of appointment in favor of one disputant over another until the dispute regarding who has the right to make the nomination is resolved by a tribunal.
rules.supporting_quote: "Until some tribunal lay or ecclesiastical, decides whose right to be the Viharadhipathi is the better one, a layman like the Public Trustee cannot be expected to say which of the two monks had the right to make the nomination for the trusteeship of this temple under Sec. 10 (1) and which under section 11 (2) the Public Trustee was bound to accept as a 'due' nomination."
